items.sentence: And with a coarser grain ten fold to four, where a build couples with them.
items.text: Two sayings part at which four the ten fold to. This sentence folds ten to four by their builds, a reference with drift, a rate with jitter, a magnitude with heat and wear, a parity going along entering as cost with a record; the sentence before it seats each of the ten with now and eight up with next, an opening fixing as a place at 1 and 9, an observing fixing from behind at 2 and 10, a two-way fixing to one side at 3 and 11, a sequencing fixing to one beat at 4 and 12, a middle fixing as an end and a between fixing as a cut at 5 and 13, a completing fixing as a last at 6 and 14, a parity fixing as a magnitude and a rate fixing as a value at 7 and 15, a same-existing fixing as a store at 8 and 16. Exhibit ONE's four four-cyclings are 1, 5, 9, 13 next-existing, 2, 6, 10, 14 now-existing, 3, 7, 11, 15 prior-existing and 4, 8, 12, 16 same-existing. By the seatings, a place, an end and a cut are next-existing, from-behind and a last are now-existing, a magnitude, a value and a side are prior-existing, a store and one beat are same-existing; by the builds, from-behind, a last and an end are one four, a beat and a value one, a magnitude and a side one, a place, a store and a cut one, and each four is one momentary or is not. The ten lay onto the four four-cyclings by their seatings, or the four of the coarser grain are a different four from the four-cyclings.
